name: Rotork plc
summary: Rotork plc manufactures industrial flow control and instrumentation solutions for the oil and gas, water and wastewater, power, chemical process, and industrial markets. It operates through three segments: Oils & Gas; Water & Power; and Chemical, Process & Industrial segments.
